title: My cooking week
instructions: Leo yemek yapmaya başladığı haftayı anlatıyor. Günleri ve yemekleri karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Last week, I started a new hobby: cooking.

script.speaker: s
script.text: On Monday, I made pasta with tomato sauce. It was easy and very good.

script.speaker: s
script.text: On Wednesday, I tried to make bread, but it was too hard. Nobody ate it!

script.speaker: s
script.text: On Friday, I made chicken soup for my mum because she was ill.

script.speaker: s
script.text: She said it was the best soup in the world.

script.speaker: s
script.text: On Saturday, my friends came to my house and I made pizza.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Next week, I want to make a chocolate cake for my sister's birthday.

questions.prompt: What did Leo make on Monday?
questions.evidence: On Monday, I made pasta with tomato sauce.

questions.prompt: What was the problem with the bread?
Why did he make soup on Friday?
What did he make for his friends?
What does he want to make next week?
questions.feedback: Kız kardeşinin doğum günü için çikolatalı pasta.
questions.evidence: I want to make a chocolate cake
